title: Photomultiplier Function
description: Essential Criteria: The response must accurately describe the basic operation of a photomultiplier tube, including the role of the cathode and dynodes.

title: Final Answer Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the ratio Delta N/N and its derivation.

title: Photon Distinction Conclusion
description: Important Criteria: The response should conclude whether the tube can distinguish between two photons differing by 50% based on the derived ratio.

title: Poisson Distribution Reference
description: Important Criteria: The response should mention the Poisson distribution and its relevance to the number of electrons collected.

title: Units and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include relevant units or constants used in the calculations for clarity.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common errors such as incorrect assumptions about the number of dynodes or miscalculating the secondary emission rate.
